setup_vasp_calc_mof: create a VASP calculator for MOF relaxation and write input files to a directory
setup_vasp_mof_and_ads: create a VASP calculator for MOF plus adsorbate relaxation and write input files
run_setup_vasp_calc_mof: run setup_vasp_calc_mof to generate VASP input files for a MOF structure from a CIF file
run_setup_vasp_mof_and_ads: run setup_vasp_mof_and_ads to generate VASP input files for a MOF with adsorbates from a CIF file
review_setup_vasp_calc_mof: review the setup_vasp_calc_mof function to understand VASP DFT parameters for MOF relaxation
